overrides.reason: The matches are values that are not words of the interface: doc-noteref and doc-endnotes are the roles of the digital publishing ARIA module that a screen reader reads a footnote by, and doc is the name of the root node of the editor's schema, which the library requires. None is shown to a person.

The match is the CSS keyword in the next/font style array, style: ['normal', 'italic'], which @ekdotico/domico/fonts requires, and not a statement about a person's writing. The rule's own text admits the CSS keyword.
